searchText: Hey <@203220829473996800> , yesterday you mentioned of an ethstats like interface to display all the nodes in the network. What data would you require for this ? We can get basic node informtation from their multiaddr/enr. If you wanted to know more about a node , we could use their status response. So we could evaluate how it is doing compared to the network,etc Updating zrnt to v0.9.3 first today, and will then open an issue for building ethstats, with requirements and existing work. Using the status response sounds like a good start <@!476250636548308992> Created an issue in the pm repo: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/116
